node.label: Scissor gait
node.definition: A type of spastic paraparetic gait in which the muscle tone in the adductors is marked. It is characterized by hypertonia and flexion in the legs, hips and pelvis accompanied by extreme adduction leading to the knees and thighs hitting, or sometimes even crossing, in a scissors-like movement. The opposing muscles (abductors) become comparatively weak from lack of use.

evidence.snippet: Spastic paraplegia 12, autosomal dominant: Scissor gait (frequency 3/3) [PCS]
